method: The attached PNG (image-0.png, 1400x721) was opened and read as a rendered image. The readings were then confirmed against the PNG's own pixels: ink extents against the canvas edge (no ink in the outer 2 px on any side; content bbox x 12-1386, y 32-679 of 1400x721), modal series colours (#929292 grey at 3.11:1 on white, #2e6fb7 blue at 5.15:1), scan of every label box for intruding marker pixels (blue pixels: 0 in each panel title and each tick-label column), and connected-component analysis of the marker clusters to test hollow-square versus filled-dot overlap. No SVG and no other image was opened. The figure was supplied as a PNG only; no caption accompanied it in this review, so caption repetition could not be judged.
